articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, March 23, 2026 – Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced the appointment of Lucas Glass as Head of Artificial Intelligence, effective April 2026. Lucas will lead the development and implementation of artificial intelligence capabilities across Royalty Pharma.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma Appoints Lucas Glass as Head of Artificial Intelligence

articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, March 30, 2026 - Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced a research and development (R&D) co-funding agreement with Johnson & Johnson for a total of $500 million in 2026 and 2027 to advance the development of JNJ-4804, an investigational medicine for autoimmune diseases.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma Announces R&D Funding Collaboration for Chronic Immune-Mediated Diseases
